proof_groups.proof_strategy: Unfold/refold CircularAreaBackingResource and apply the existing full/empty query-state helper lemmas.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: The invariant's logical length, index recurrence, and status equivalences determine every full/empty branch; all spatial resources are unchanged.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Normalize unsigned index arithmetic, unfold result predicates, and use CircularArea_data_length_mod__length_and_divide_results.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: Index and length bounds from the invariant prevent machine wrapping; helper results then coincide with logical FIFO length and wrap/nonwrap guards.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Unfold Empty/DataLength/Divide result predicates and reduce Z.min using the existing call-normalization lemmas.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: Nonempty logical state makes the actual length positive; requested-vs-length decides whether the actual is the full logical length or requested length.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Use ArrayLib split lemmas and the existing nonwrap/wrap InitializedSlice helpers, then discharge memcpy sublist lengths.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: CircularAreaLiveBytes guarantees precisely the physical live slices consumed by each memcpy; splitting mixed_full preserves unknown cells outside those slices.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Merge array segments, instantiate CircularAreaReadSuccess, and apply CircularArea_consume_logical_state__read_postconditions; select direct error disjuncts for failures.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: Successful reads copy the logical prefix, retain the suffix, advance readidx modulo capacity, and preserve the mixed physical representation; failures preserve both owned resources.
